findings.title: Overprivileged Full Google Drive Access: "Gemini for Workspace Studio (Web Application)"
findings.details: "Gemini for Workspace Studio (Web Application)" holds the full Drive scope ('.../auth/drive'), allowing complete read, write, and deletion access to all files in the user's Google Drive and Shared Drives.
findings.remediation: Evaluate if the application can function with restricted scopes (such as 'drive.file' for user-selected files or 'drive.readonly'). In Google Admin Console, set this app to 'Limited' or 'Blocked' in API Controls.
findings.adminConsolePath: Security > Access and data control > API controls > App access control
